checks.name: unknown_source_permission
checks.details: Granted Allow from this source through the actual Android Settings screen; no appops permission bypass was used.

checks.name: offline_install_all_three
checks.details: Installed AAIdrive, AAIdrive Projection and upstream Open Headunit from the final Setup APK with Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled. Each native Android installation prompt was explicitly approved.

checks.name: cancel_and_resume
checks.details: After AAIdrive installed, canceled the Projection installation prompt. Setup stopped, kept AAIdrive, and reported Projection was not installed. Resuming Install everything skipped AAIdrive, installed Projection and automatically advanced to Open Headunit.

checks.name: archive_and_installed_package_verification
checks.details: Real PackageManager archive/version/current-signer checks and FileProvider content URIs succeeded for all three payloads. Setup reported every installed app compatible.

checks.name: fresh_launch_skips_installed_apps
checks.details: Force-stopped and reopened Setup after completion. It recognized all three installed apps, displayed the all-ready message, disabled Install everything and opened no installation prompt.

checks.name: launch_projection
checks.details: Displayed the projection setup screen and expected screen-capture permission-needed status.

checks.name: launch_open_headunit
checks.details: Displayed Open Headunit welcome, language and onboarding controls; no configuration beyond its initial screen was attempted.

scope: Installer and initial-launch smoke test only; no physical BMW, Pixel, Android Auto session or measured projection performance.
